stem: From the top of a tower, a stone is thrown up and reaches the ground in time $t_{1}$. A second stone is thrown down with the same speed and reaches the ground in time $t_{2}$. A third stone is released from rest and reaches the ground in time $t_{3}$; then what is the relation between the three times?

assets.alt: Three balls from the top of a tower of height H: one thrown up at u (time t₁), one thrown down at u (time t₂) and one dropped (time t₃, dashed).
